snippet.title: PiPu Party | Indie Party Game | Gameplay Reveal Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
PiPu Party is a chaotic party puzzle-platformer game with a shared 3-slot symbol backpack. Pick and put symbols to alter the level. Co-op or outsmart your friends.
Wishlist Now on Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4078600/PiPu_Party/
